about_the_game:
Trauma Football is sweeping the nation!

Experience the thrill of dealing with a mentally unstable boss, nagging journalists and social climbers, all the while having to keep up with top players from all around the world!

Trauma Football features:

-A gameplay loop unlike anything you've ever seen in a football game (or any sports game, for that matter!) lovingly crafted to keep both newcomers and experts engaged from beginning to end!

-An extensive editor that allows you to modify not just the appearance, but also the skills, the formation and the behaviour of your team!

-A narratively intruguing Season mode with an unmatched variety of challenges and scenarios to test your skills with!

-Multiple ways to customize every single game! Put your team of 5 against a team of 8, 11 or just one player, and vice-versa! Set up penalties if your opponent does certain actions, change the weather, the goal size, the time limit, the world is your oyster!

-Illegal sports betting.

-A slew of unlockable secrets, mini-games and unique features to keep the player always wanting for more!

content_descriptors.notes:
Decent amount of swearing and risqué humor all around. Nothing too controversial or anything.

Mostly edgy jokes about drunken sex and consumption of drugs and having to deal with unsavory people. 
And suicide, you can do that. And male/female social dynamics, and just in general everyone is having a bad time and it shows.
And people talk about killing other people a lot.
